lane: H84B-UAS — Uncertainty-Adaptive Spacing on a distance-blind bagged-HGB surface (59 physical channels, NO catalogue-distance feature). NOTE IR-84B-01: the session prompt's 'single method paragraph below' was absent as received; lane self-defined and preregistered in research/h84b_uas_hypotheses.md BEFORE any experiment, amended on record before EXP-84B-3.
hypothesis: H-UAS-1: matching dot spacing to local trace-location uncertainty (dense 1.5px where certain, sparse 3.4px where not) beats H33-style fixed 2.83px spacing at equal dot budget, because on a correctly located trace extra dots cost ~0 FP (k_self~1) and raise max-kernel TP_w, while under positional uncertainty dense dots cannibalise kernel disks.
mechanism: Bagged HistGradientBoosting (4 seeds, 70% row bags) -> mean surface mu(x) + disagreement sigma(x); greedy emission sorted by mu with per-dot exclusion disk s(x); collar d_cat>2px; budget-matched 37,654 dots. EXP-3 variant: s(x) driven by positional sharpness h(x)=mu-blur2(mu) (preregistered H-UAS-4 variable).
named_non_fault_mimic: Ensemble disagreement/sharpness also peak at lithologic contacts, caldera margins and road corridors (mapping ambiguity, not faulting); empirically sigma tracked decision-boundary ambiguity mu(1-mu), raw AUC 0.61-0.64 FOR withheld faults, inverting the intended spacing response.

holdout.evaluator: exact finite-kernel weighted dilation (alpha 0.2, beta 0.8, R 3px triangular), verified identical to vendor gems57 dti_binary/dti_exact to <1e-5 on synthetic cases this session
holdout.design: hide-and-recover: 6x6 spatial blocks in 4 checkerboard fold groups; whole connected fault segments withheld; 3px buffer excluded from training and scoring; per-fold retraining on visible segments only; pooled TP/FP/FN across folds; 95% CI by block bootstrap (2000 resamples over per-block components)
